title: A Counting Lemma for Somewhat Restricted 3-APs
summary: For a prime $p\geq 3$, a somewhat restricted $3$-AP in $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ is a triplet $(x,x+a,x+2a)$, where $x\in\mathbb{F}_p^n$ and $a\in \{0,1,2\}^n$. We prove a counting lemma for somewhat restricted $3$-APs in dense sets in $\mathbb{F}_p^n$. More precisely, we prove that for all $α>0$, there exists $β>0$, such that for sufficiently large $n$, if a set $A\subseteq \mathbb{F}_p^n$ has density at least $α$, then it contains at least $β$ fraction of all somewhat restricted $3$-APs.
